author: reek
body: Writes a new file into a mounted FAT16 volume, then reads it back through the normal path, and confirms an existing file (HELLO.TXT) still reads. The disk is the same GPT+FAT16 image the read test uses; the harness runs against a writable copy, so the write mutates scratch, not the depot.

author: reek
body: A pass proves the whole write layer: free-cluster search, both FAT copies updated, cluster data written, and a root directory entry added -- without disturbing the clusters or FAT of the file already there.
